references.role: Approved illustration: tool and soil continuity, not new turf evidence

assets.purpose: Show the spade slicing below the root mat, manageable rectangular pieces and a shallow cleared patch.
assets.factualVisualReview: Grass uppermost; blade under thin turf, not digging a trench; entire simplified spade visible. At print size the grid, blade and lifted edge remain distinguishable.
assets.styleReview: Broad graphic colour planes, bold silhouettes, vivid greens and clear highlights match direct hero references; simplified soil and tool treatment continues approved digging art. No generated lettering.

assets.purpose: Show upside-down layers under a weighted cover.
assets.factualVisualReview: All five depicted layers have soil up and grass down; brown uppermost face; opaque cover and weights clear. Caption explains the cover is folded back for visibility. Layer count is illustrative, not a quantity instruction.
assets.styleReview: Broad graphic colour planes, bold silhouettes, vivid greens and clear highlights match direct hero references; simplified soil and tool treatment continues approved digging art. No generated lettering.

assets.tool: editable vector schematic with native text
assets.purpose: Show topsoil above inverted turf above loosened subsoil; keep soil horizons separate.
assets.factualVisualReview: Leader endpoints identify topsoil, lower grassy face of inverted turf, and loosened subsoil. Fine roots face upward in the inverted turf. No depth scale implied; schematic clods show loosened lower soil.
assets.styleReview: Uses book greens and warm earth colours; diagram deliberately simpler than the raster drawings to preserve exact layer order and editable labels.
